summary: Iter17 real-time admin notifications for pending receipts: all backend + UI checks passed. Global AdminNotifier fires Sonner toast on any route when a fresh receipt lands (verified from /home), the /admin Verification tab auto-refreshes within ~10s, non-admin users get no toast and no console crash despite the endpoint returning 403, and the iter16 SBP-phone + full manual-approval regression (submit → approve → +coins + Premium) still passes end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminNotifier polls even when the browser tab is hidden — consider pausing on document.hidden to reduce load; non-blocking.
Notification icon uses '/manifest.json' as the icon URL which is a JSON manifest, not an image; native OS notifications will show a broken icon. Suggest pointing to a real PNG (e.g. /favicon.png).
Poll error is swallowed with an empty catch — logging a debug hint (e.g. console.debug) would help future diagnosis without leaking errors to users.
